info.title: Anime Image Manager
info.description: Backend to manage and access images

get.summary: Retrieves a list of all users with their ID, roles, and approval status.
Retrieves a list of all pending (unapproved) users.

post.summary: Approves a user, allowing them to log in.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The ID of the user to approve.

post.summary: Promotes a user to administrator role.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The ID of the user to promote.

post.summary: Demotes an administrator to a regular user by removing their administrator role.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The ID of the administrator to demote.

post.summary:
Toggles the approval status of a user (enables/disables their account).
If the user is approved, they will be disabled. If disabled, they will be approved.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The ID of the user to toggle approval status for.

post.summary: Creates a new user account with the supplied email and password.
Authenticates a user and issues an authentication cookie/session.

get.summary: Retrieves a paginated list of characters optionally filtered by an optional token.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Optional filter token.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1‑based).

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of items per page.

get.summary: Searches for characters matching the supplied query string.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search term.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Optional filter token.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1‑based).

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of items per page.

get.summary:
Returns a paginated list of images that the user can access.  
If no authentication is required, this endpoint remains open to anonymous users.

put.summary:
Uploads a new image and returns its GUID.  
Requires the caller to be authenticated.

delete.summary:
Deletes an existing image.  
Only the owner or an administrator can delete; otherwise a 403 is returned.

get.summary:
Streams the raw image file to the caller.  
The MIME type is now inferred from the image record or by inspecting the file header.

Retrieves public metadata for an image (tags, characters, rating, owners).  
Access is validated against the supplied token.q

Streams the raw image file to the caller.  
The MIME type is now inferred from the image record or by inspecting the file header.
Streams the thumbnail image file to the caller.

Searches images by tags, characters or rating.  
Returns a paginated result set.

put.summary: Adds a new platform token for the current user.

get.summary: Retrieves all platform tokens owned by the current user.
Retrieves sync logs for a specific platform token.

delete.summary: Deletes a platform token by its GUID.

post.summary: Run the sync service on a token

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Identifier of token

post.summary: Creates a new platform‑token for the image identified by imageId.

parameters.name: imageId
parameters.description: The GUID of the target image.

requestBody.description: Request body containing the desired token expiration date/time.

get.summary: Returns a paginated list of tags that the current user is allowed to see.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Optional share‑token that grants temporary access to private tags.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1‑based). Defaults to 1.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of items per page. Max 200.

get.summary: Searches for tags that match the supplied query string.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search term; an empty string returns all tags.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Optional share‑token that grants temporary access to private tags.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1‑based). Defaults to 1.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of items per page. Max 200.

get.summary: Returns basic profile data for the authenticated user.

AddPlatformTokenRequest.description: Payload used when creating a platform share token.

AddTokenRequest.description: Payload used when creating a new platform token.

GetCharacterResponse.description: Response model for a single character statistic.

GetImagesResponse.description: Response returned for a paginated list of images.

GetSearchImagesResponse.description: Response returned for a paginated list of search results.

GetUserInfoResponse.description:
DTO returned by the user‑info service.
It contains the authenticated user's basic profile data, roles, and the default publicity level
used when that user uploads a new image.

ImageDataResponse.description: Full image data exposed to the caller.

PlatformTokenDto.description:
Data transfer object returned by the service for a stored token.
Includes derived properties such as ImageManager.Services.PlatformTokens.PlatformTokenDto.IsExpired.

PlatformTokenSyncLog.description: Data transfer object returned by the service for a sync.

RegisterRequest.description: Payload for registering a new user.

TagCountDto.description:
Represents a tag together with the number of times it occurs in the current context.
The controller simply forwards this DTO to the client.

UserListResponse.description: DTO representing a user with their ID, username, roles, and approval status.
